nodes.label: Four-day roster trial
nodes.excerpt: A three-month trial of four ten-hour days for the Workshop team. Managed in the Rostering app; reviewed at the Monthly review.

nodes.label: Free shipping threshold
nodes.excerpt: Free shipping on online orders over $150, proposed by the Online sales coordinator. Applies to Online order fulfilment; set in the Online store.

nodes.label: Move to e-bike servicing
nodes.excerpt: Decided by the Owner on advice from the Head mechanic: train two mechanics and buy diagnostic tools so e-bikes can be serviced in house. Led to E-bike diagnostics and Open a second workshop bay.

nodes.label: Open a second workshop bay
nodes.excerpt: Approved by the Owner once e-bike work grew. Capacity is tracked in the Workshop scheduler. Follows Move to e-bike servicing.

nodes.label: Stop selling kids bikes online
nodes.excerpt: Too many returns on sizing. Kids bikes stay in store only. Affects the Online store and Returns and refunds.

nodes.label: Switch accounting software
nodes.excerpt: The Finance administrator compared three options; the move cuts Month-end close from four days to two. Affects the Accounting system and Payroll.

nodes.label: Fernhill Cycles
nodes.excerpt: A fictional bike shop and service workshop with about 25 staff, used as sample data. Start with Owner, the Workshop team and the Sales team. The busiest processes are Bike service booking, Online order fulfilment and Weekly stocktake. The main systems are Point of sale, Workshop…

nodes.label: Pricing policy
nodes.excerpt: Owned by the Owner. New bikes at recommended retail; service labour at a fixed hourly rate. Priced from Trade-in valuation plus a 30% margin.

nodes.label: Privacy policy
nodes.excerpt: What customer data is kept in the Customer database, for how long, and who can see it. Reviewed yearly at the Monthly review.

nodes.label: Returns policy
nodes.excerpt: 30 days, proof of purchase, unused condition. Applied through Returns and refunds.

nodes.label: Workshop safety policy
nodes.excerpt: Eye protection, tidy benches, stands rated for the bike. E-bike batteries are stored and charged in the fire cabinet. Applies to E-bike diagnostics.

nodes.label: Bike service booking
nodes.excerpt: 1. Customer books online or in store; the booking lands in the Workshop scheduler. 2. A Mechanic checks the bike in and records the job. 3. Parts are reserved in the Inventory system. 4. On completion the customer is texted and pays through Point of sale. Owner: Head mechanic. E…

nodes.label: Click and collect
nodes.excerpt: Online orders held at the counter for seven days. The Sales team checks ID at pickup and closes the order in Point of sale. Part of Online order fulfilment.

nodes.label: E-bike diagnostics
nodes.excerpt: Battery and motor checks before any e-bike service. Needs the manufacturer's tool and a trained Mechanic. Added after Move to e-bike servicing. Follows Workshop safety policy.

nodes.label: In-store sale
nodes.excerpt: Sell through Point of sale, capture the customer in the Customer database with consent, and offer a first free service via Bike service booking. Prices follow Pricing policy. Owner: Sales lead.

nodes.label: Month-end close
nodes.excerpt: Reconcile bank, Point of sale takings and supplier accounts in the Accounting system, then send the pack to the Monthly review. Owner: Finance administrator.

nodes.label: Monthly review
nodes.excerpt: The Owner, Operations manager and Finance administrator go through the Month-end close pack, workshop utilisation from the Workshop scheduler and open decisions.

nodes.label: Online order fulfilment
nodes.excerpt: 1. Order arrives from the Online store. 2. Stock is picked and marked in the Inventory system. 3. Courier label printed; customer emailed tracking. Shipping is free above the Free shipping threshold. Owner: Online sales coordinator. Store pickups go through Click and collect.

nodes.label: Payroll
nodes.excerpt: Fortnightly. Hours come from the Rostering app, pay runs in the Accounting system. Owner: Finance administrator. See Four-day roster trial for the current exception.

nodes.label: Returns and refunds
nodes.excerpt: Within 30 days with proof of purchase, as set by Returns policy. Processed in Point of sale; faulty items go to Warranty claims.

nodes.label: Staff onboarding
nodes.excerpt: First week: Workshop safety policy or Returns policy depending on role, logins to Point of sale and Rostering app, and a buddy shift. Mechanics shadow the Head mechanic for two weeks.

nodes.label: Staff rostering
nodes.excerpt: The Operations manager publishes the roster in the Rostering app two weeks ahead. Workshop cover follows Workshop scheduler bookings.

nodes.label: Supplier ordering
nodes.excerpt: Orders go out on Tuesdays from the reorder list in the Inventory system. Invoices are passed to Supplier payments. Owner: Operations manager.

nodes.label: Supplier payments
nodes.excerpt: Paid fortnightly from the Accounting system after matching each invoice to its order from Supplier ordering. Owner: Finance administrator.

nodes.label: Trade-in valuation
nodes.excerpt: The Sales lead values a trade-in from the condition checklist; a Mechanic confirms anything over $1,000. Accepted bikes go into the Inventory system as used stock. Follows Pricing policy.

nodes.label: Warranty claims
nodes.excerpt: When a part fails under warranty the Mechanic photographs it, the Head mechanic lodges the claim with the supplier and the credit is matched in the Accounting system. Related: Returns and refunds, Supplier ordering.

nodes.label: Weekly stocktake
nodes.excerpt: Every Monday the Operations manager counts fast-moving parts and reconciles them with the Inventory system. Shortfalls feed Supplier ordering.

nodes.label: Finance administrator
nodes.excerpt: Runs Month-end close, Payroll and Supplier payments in the Accounting system. Prepared the numbers for Switch accounting software. Reports to the Owner.

nodes.label: Head mechanic
nodes.excerpt: Leads the Workshop team. Owns Bike service booking, Warranty claims and E-bike diagnostics. Trains new Mechanics through Staff onboarding. Uses the Workshop scheduler every day and raised Move to e-bike servicing.

nodes.label: Mechanic
nodes.excerpt: Services and repairs bikes. Follows Bike service booking and Workshop safety policy. Logs parts used in the Inventory system and time in the Workshop scheduler. Reports to the Head mechanic.

nodes.label: Online sales coordinator
nodes.excerpt: Owns Online order fulfilment and keeps the Online store listings accurate against the Inventory system. Handles Click and collect with the Sales team. Proposed Free shipping threshold.

nodes.label: Operations manager
nodes.excerpt: Runs the day to day. Owns Weekly stocktake, Supplier ordering and the Staff rostering process, and leads the Workshop team and Sales team stand-ups. Main systems: Inventory system, Rostering app. Reports to the Owner.

nodes.label: Owner
nodes.excerpt: Sets direction and signs off spending over $5,000. Chairs the Monthly review and owns Pricing policy. Made the calls on Move to e-bike servicing and Open a second workshop bay. Works closely with the Operations manager and the Finance administrator.

nodes.label: Sales assistant
nodes.excerpt: Serves customers in the shop. Follows In-store sale and Returns and refunds. Books services through Bike service booking. Reports to the Sales lead.

nodes.label: Sales lead
nodes.excerpt: Leads the Sales team on the shop floor. Owns In-store sale, Trade-in valuation and Returns and refunds. Uses Point of sale and the Customer database. Works with the Online sales coordinator on stock that sells in both places.

nodes.label: Accounting system
nodes.excerpt: General ledger, supplier bills and payroll. Being replaced, see Switch accounting software.

nodes.label: Customer database
nodes.excerpt: Customer contacts, bikes owned and service history. Fed by Point of sale and the Online store. Governed by Privacy policy.

nodes.label: Inventory system
nodes.excerpt: Stock levels for new bikes, used bikes and parts. Updated by Point of sale and Online store sales. Source of truth for Weekly stocktake and Supplier ordering.

nodes.label: Online store
nodes.excerpt: The web shop. Pulls stock from the Inventory system, sends orders to Online order fulfilment and service bookings to the Workshop scheduler.

nodes.label: Point of sale
nodes.excerpt: Tills in store. Syncs sales to the Inventory system and daily takings to the Accounting system. Customer records go to the Customer database.

nodes.label: Rostering app
nodes.excerpt: Rosters, leave and timesheets. Feeds Payroll.

nodes.label: Workshop scheduler
nodes.excerpt: Bookings, job cards and mechanic time. Fed by the Online store booking form and used for Bike service booking.

nodes.label: Back office
nodes.excerpt: The Operations manager and the Finance administrator. Owns Month-end close, Payroll, Supplier ordering and Staff rostering.

nodes.label: Sales team
nodes.excerpt: The Sales lead, three Sales assistants and the Online sales coordinator. Owns In-store sale, Click and collect and Returns and refunds.

nodes.label: Workshop team
nodes.excerpt: The Head mechanic and four Mechanics. Meets each morning before opening. Owns Bike service booking, Warranty claims and E-bike diagnostics. Lives in the Workshop scheduler.
